# VeriTile/Dist

Sources of the lake target `VeriTileDist`: the location and agent model, events, schedules and the judgments over every complete schedule for Triton-distributed and TileScale kernels.
`VeriTile/Dist.lean` is its root module.

No `sorry`, no import from `VeriTile/Staging/`, no new axiom; see
[the staging rules and gates](../Staging/README.md).
